definitions.explanation: measures taken as an immediate response to an urgent situation

examples.japanese: {応急|おうきゅう}{処置|しょち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{応急|おうきゅう}{手当|てあて}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{応急|おうきゅう}⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I did a makeshift repair on the broken window.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- {応急|おうきゅう}{処置|しょち} (first aid, emergency treatment)
- {応急|おうきゅう}{手当|てあて} (first-aid treatment)
- {応急|おうきゅう}⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧ (emergency/makeshift repair)
- {応急|おうきゅう}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧ (emergency measures)

USAGE:
Almost always used as a prefix in compounds rather than independently. Implies temporary, immediate action until proper treatment or repair can be done.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧ (urgent, emergency)
- ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧ (emergency medical - ambulance context)
